text:
Matvei Michkov is answering a loud week with his stick. His name has been all over the trade-rumor sites, Rick Tocchet told PhillyVoice the Flyers handled the noise "really well" while admitting it's there, and Kevin Kurz of The Athletic reported, per a team source, that Michkov has not requested a trade. Michkov's reply: a five-game point streak, and a "brilliant one-man effort," in Kurz's words, to help beat Columbus.

He's 21 with 19 points in 24 games, nearly double the median pace for forwards picked where he was (fifth to ninth overall) in their first full season. The goals come with a caution: 11 on 6.4 expected (the quality of his chances), shooting 30%, a rate that rarely lasts. Balancing that, the Flyers have scored 8.7 fewer goals than their chances deserve with him on the ice, which has cost him assists.

He is neither fast nor a heavy shooter by NHL Edge, but Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him getting to the front of the net as often as almost any forward. Watch whether the assists pick up the slack when the shooting cools.
